title: tanacetum leucanthemum var. maximum
intro: Tanacetum leucanthemum var. maximum, commonly known as Tansy or White Tansy, is a perennial plant species in the sunflower family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and carminative properties, making it useful for treating conditions such as digestive issues, pain, and anxiety. The bioactive constituents present in Tanacetum leucanthemum var. maximum include flavonoids, volatile oils, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. These constituents, along with the plant's other health benefits, have led to its use in herbal medicine for various purposes, including as a treatment for fever, skin conditions, and as a natural insect repellent.
